_why: The petname each node id gets from the pinned mesh server, so Martha's own copy of the derivation (./name_a_node_by_its_petname.ts) is proved against the server and not against itself (martha#251). Taken by ../record_mesh_answers from the installed module's own petname(): `node -e "import('<tree>/node_modules/@macula-io/mcp/dist/petname.js').then((m) => m.petname(id))"`. No id here is anybody's: each is written as how it is made — 64 copies of one hex digit, or the sha256 of a written-down name — so every pair can be re-taken and a public repository keeps no node id, not even a synthetic one written as 64 hex. The same seven pairs were read from 0.51.0 and 0.51.2.
